name: component_comparison_v2
status: PROPOSED revision 3 after second red-team (FREEZE-WITH-AMENDMENTS: N1-N9, N13 required; N10-N12, N14 recommended; all addressed)
supersedes: none; component_comparison_v1 is retained unchanged as the comparator
question: does the revised logic recognise arrival at the requested goal, and recover from localisation ambiguity, rather than only suppressing declarations?

checkpoint.name: ft-seed0
checkpoint.reason: held fixed across variants; the stronger checkpoint on the previous comparison

runtime.controller: reference PD dt 0.5 s + 120 Hz yaw PI (qualification articulated-control-20261009-10)

true_chain.tests: route following and correct stopping; consistent-chain look-alikes (the two point-symmetric s_bend bends; mid-route views) occur naturally

truncated_chain.tests: same-scene mismatch: chain ends 0.75-0.96 m short of the requested goal; a chain-only arrival rule declares arrival at the wrong place; verification should withhold it and steer to the requested goal

wrong_chain_swap.tests: gross cross-scene mismatch (junction_0 chain in the s_bend scene), one route

B1_bounded.role: v1 comparator: bounded progression + v1 lost state

B1x_exit.role: control for R2: B1's lost behaviour (follow the global argmin while moving, stay lost until relocalised or the episode budget) with R2's exit threshold 5.881. R2 differs from B1x by the in-place scan, the scan budget and lost-entry limit with a terminal halt, and non-arrival relocalisation decisions; a difference is attributable to that bundle, not to the scan alone

R2_recover.role: B1 entry and bounded progression unchanged; lost behaviour replaced by the in-place scan, the 36-decision scan budget and 2-entry limit with terminal halt, non-arrival relocalisation, and exit 5.881 (shared with B1x). bounded.lost_exit (2.215) is unused by R2

V2a_confirm.role: changes only C1's arrival logic: latched eligibility, 2-of-4 evidence, abstention budget; steering as C1 (requested-goal waypoint only on chain-end decisions)

V2b_confirm_steer.role: V2a plus steering by the requested goal throughout the approach phase. V2b's result is attributable to confirmation plus steering; steering without confirmation is not tested

component_definitions.confirmation: src/navfm/collection/arrival_confirmation.py: approach latches at the first chain-end decision and never unlatches; each approach decision votes requested-goal distance <= 7.745; votes expire after 4 decisions; confirmed when >= 2 of the last 4 vote; V2a steers as C1 (requested-goal waypoint on chain-end decisions only); V2b steers by the requested-goal waypoint throughout the approach; a lost pause clears votes and does not consume the approach budget; 40 approach decisions without confirmation = ABSTAINED (terminal non-arrival halt)
component_definitions.recovery: src/navfm/collection/topomap.py RecoveringTopomapState: entry unchanged (window minimum > 6.752 on 3 decisions); while lost the robot does not translate and rotates in place at 0.4 rad/s; every node scored; relocalise when the global argmin distance <= 5.881 on 2 consecutive decisions at the same node (+/-1); a relocalisation decision is never an arrival; 36 scan decisions without relocalising, or a third lost entry, = recovery_failed (terminal non-arrival halt)
component_definitions.terminals: ARRIVED (policy_stop_frame) is the only arrival. ABSTAINED (policy_abstain_frame, reason confirmation_budget or recovery_failed) is a non-arrival halt. The episode budget is separate (timeout). Under arrival_measures_v1 an abstention has no stop decision (timeout field true); it is reported separately as abstention, never as a correct or wrong stop. For an abstention the task end under arrival_measures_v1 is the last recorded frame (abstention + 24 stationary frames), as for a timeout; contacts in that tail count
component_definitions.ground_truth: pose is used only for evaluation, calibration and to place the robot at trial starts; it never enters a decision
component_definitions.matched_state_start: resume trials teleport the robot to the pose whose image the recorded decision saw (frame f-1 for decision frame f; verified offline: max distance difference 0.10-0.14 against 0.6-2.3 for frame f), seed the 6-image history from the recorded frames, and set the initial node to the recorded node before that decision (a policy output, not ground truth). The robot starts at rest, unlike the recorded run (0.1 m/s). The effective initial node and lost state are recorded per episode in manifest topomap.initial_node / start_lost; the resumed episode's checkpoint must equal this checkpoint

confirmation_threshold.data: tm-ft-seed0-02, wc-ft-seed0-02, closedloop-yawfb-ft-seed0-02 (v1 calibration; unchanged so the v2 difference is logic only)

recovery_exit.rule: scripts/calibrate_recovery_v2.py: 90th percentile of the LOCAL window minimum on correctly localised on-route forward-view decisions (151 decisions, one recording, about 15 tail points). Relocalisation thresholds the GLOBAL minimum over all nodes, where aliasing lives, and scan views are absent from the data; '0/71 off-route at or below' is therefore not a bound on spurious global relocalisation. Spurious global matches are measured in stage 2 (lost_false_global_matches)

calibration.fixed_a_priori_not_fitted: votes 2, window 4, approach budget 40 decisions (20 s), scan rate 0.4 rad/s (the qualified in-place command: steady 0.38-0.39 rad/s with 0.031-0.034 m/s translation creep), scan budget 36 decisions (one revolution at 0.38 rad/s is 33), max 2 lost entries. All v2 parameters were chosen after reading the 44 v1 episodes
calibration.route_overlap: every calibration recording, the stage-1 replay set (the 44 v1 comparison episodes) and every v2 trial use the same four development routes, two scenes and the same chains and goals. v2 trials are fresh episodes, so they test development repeatability of a frozen rule, not generalisation

1_logic_replay.input: the 44 v1 comparison episodes (cmp-*-20261009-01): recorded chain flags, requested-goal distances and lost flags, decisions up to and including the recorded stop; open loop (v2 steering is not replayed). Distances scored at frame f-1 (the image the decision saw); D's lost flags enter as pauses, which V2 (unbounded) would not have

criteria.S1a_no_false_confirmation: replayed V2 logic never confirms at a decision > 0.5 m from the goal (the arrival radius). Vacuous on the 22 A/B sequences that end at their first chain-end decision; reported with the number of sequences where confirmation was possible
criteria.S1b_alternation: on the C1 truncated junction sequences, replayed V2 confirms inside the goal region (<= 0.5 m)
criteria.S1c_true_chain_retained: on every true-chain or repeat sequence of C_verify or D_both (the variants whose recorded runs continued past the chain end) that ended in a v1 correct stop, replayed V2 confirms at <= 0.5 m within 2 decisions of the first chain-end decision. A and B sequences end at their own chain-end stop and cannot show this. Near-tautological: V2's rule is weaker than C1's after the latch, so it confirms where C1 accepted; it checks only that nothing breaks

1_logic_replay.gate: S1a and S1c pass for V2a/V2b to enter stage 2; S1b reported
1_logic_replay.label: IN-SAMPLE CONSISTENCY CHECK, not evidence: the v2 parameters were set after reading these 44 episodes, and S1b's pattern is the design target

2_targeted.ambiguity: trials ambiguity_*: A vs B1 from 5 matched states (A's recorded decisions 13, 14, 20, 21, 22 on s_bend_run_0000), each from two v1 episodes (true, rep) that are within about 0.01 m at these decisions: replicates of one start, not independent starts. Decisions 13-14 precede A's wrong backward step at decision 14; 20-22 precede and contain the decision-22 look-alike. Starts at 20-22 place B1 on A's diverged path, a state B1 did not reach in closed loop
2_targeted.recovery: trials kidnapped_*: B1, B1x and R2 started lost at 16 perturbed mid-route poses (4 routes x 4 perturbations); kidnapped_c and kidnapped_d face away from the route (yaw 180 and 90 degrees), so the first view is uninformative and the scan is needed
2_targeted.arrival: trial arrival_truncated: A, C1, V2a, V2b on the 4 truncated chains (requested goal 0.75-0.96 m beyond the chain end)
2_targeted.premature: trials premature_*: A, C1, V2a, V2b from A's decision-22 matched state on the true s_bend_run_0000 chain (two replicates)

stages.3_complete: trials complete_*: only components that pass their stage-2 gate, each with its v1 counterpart and A, fresh episodes on true, truncated and swap chains (9 per variant)

definitions.encounter: a decision whose argmin node is >= 3 nodes from the pose-true nearest node while the policy's previous current node is within 1 of it; lost-state decisions count (a lost policy following the aliased node is following it); only decisions up to the task end (stop or abstention decision) count
definitions.correction: an encounter after which the followed node that decision and the current node for the next 10 decisions stay within 1 node of the pose-true node; needs 10 decisions before the task end, else NOT_EVALUABLE
definitions.followed: an encounter whose followed node that decision is > 1 node from the pose-true node
definitions.avoidance: a trial with no encounter (the mechanism is then NOT TESTED in that trial)
definitions.route_following_after: route departure (> 0.5 m lateral) and maximum lateral deviation after the first encounter (or after the start if none), and terminal outcome
definitions.recovery_success: a lost episode ending in relocalisation to a node within 1 of the pose-true node, with no lost re-entry in the next 10 decisions; reported per lost entry and per trial; B1 counts its v1 'recovered' event the same way; the heading rotated between entry and relocalisation is logged (evaluation only); trial success = the first lost entry (the kidnapped start) succeeds
definitions.added_stopping_delay: decisions and seconds from the first chain-end decision (chain reached flag first true) to the stop, for correct stops
definitions.contact_incidence: arrival_measures_v1 collision_before_task_end per attempt (the task ends at the stop, the abstention or the budget)
definitions.withheld_then_lost_track: an encounter not followed that decision, after which the current node leaves the pose-true node by more than 1 within 10 decisions
definitions.backward_step: a non-lost decision whose upstream proposal (argmin node, +1 if within the close threshold) is below the previous current node; reported per trial with whether it was accepted and whether the proposal was closer to the pose-true node (descriptive, no gate; v1 offline: 36 of 57 withheld backward proposals favoured the proposal)
definitions.premature_latch: the confirmation approach phase latched while the robot is more than 0.5 m (the arrival radius) from the goal, scored at frame f-1 (evaluation only); v1 risk: requested-goal votes 0.59-0.84 m from the goal on s_bend_run_0000 decisions 26-36
definitions.lost_false_global_matches: lost decisions whose global argmin distance is <= the variant's exit threshold at a node more than 1 from the pose-true node
definitions.contact_exposure: contacts are reported with path length and exposure time; the per-exposure comparison uses contacts per metre (exposure time includes stationary tails); halting variants travel less, so raw comparisons are non-regression guards only

gates_to_stage_3.all: a gate is INCOMPLETE unless it has zero integrity failures, identical non-repo influencing files across all attempts and every planned attempt present (retry rule)
gates_to_stage_3.B1_bounded (look-alike): NOT_TESTED if A follows the look-alike in no ambiguity trial (the starts did not reproduce the failure) or B1 has no evaluable encounter; otherwise PASS iff every evaluable B1 encounter is corrected AND B1 contacts <= A contacts
gates_to_stage_3.R2_recover: PASS iff on the 8 uninformative-view trials R2 first-entry successes >= 6 AND > B1x's; over all 16 R2 successes >= B1x's; R2 wrong stops <= B1x's; R2 contacts <= B1x's both raw and per metre
gates_to_stage_3.V2a_confirm and V2b_confirm_steer (each): PASS iff on arrival_truncated: correct stops >= 3 of 4, wrong stops 0, contacts <= A's, correct stops > C1's; AND on premature_*: wrong stops 0. The V2b minus V2a difference (correct, wrong, contacts) is reported descriptively
gates_to_stage_3.note: each component advances separately; a failed gate is reported as a result, not repaired within v2

reporting: all attempts per variant x trial, including failed, refused and excluded attempts, with reasons; counts only; paired per start; no significance claims; integrity as in v1 (scripts/analyse_component_comparison.py extended to v2)
known_limitations: one checkpoint, four routes, two scenes, one seed; the look-alike exists on one route
ambiguity starts: 5 distinct states, each replicated from two near-identical v1 episodes; starts at 20-22 put B1 on A's diverged path
matched-state starts begin at rest, with JPEG-decoded history
runs are not bit-deterministic (start poses differ by about 2e-5 m); paired trials are not counterfactual replicas
the recovery exit rests on about 15 tail points from one recording of local forward-view minima; global and scan-view behaviour are measured, not calibrated
in-place scanning creeps about 0.03 m/s (a circle of radius about 0.09 m); contacts during scans count
abstention and scan halts reduce exposure; raw contact comparisons are non-regression guards only
pause semantics of the confirmation state are unit-tested only: V2a/V2b have no lost state
V2 with R2 together is not tested
v2 reruns of A, B1 and C1 run new source blobs; their behaviour equivalence to v1 is shown by a recorded-decision regression test, not by identical source

the v1-equivalence regression covers the A and B state machines (incl. lost entry, not the v1 'recovered' path); the C1 verification path and the policy step are covered by unit tests, not by recorded decisions
the recovery exit threshold is calibrated on local window minima and applied to global minima (documented; measured as lost_false_global_matches)

complete_true_chain.question: complete episodes (only components that pass their stage-2 gate, with their v1 counterparts and A)

complete_truncated_chain.question: complete episodes (only components that pass their stage-2 gate, with their v1 counterparts and A)

complete_wrong_chain_swap.question: complete episodes (only components that pass their stage-2 gate, with their v1 counterparts and A)

premature_true_d22.question: premature confirmation
premature_true_d22.why: v1: after A's decision-22 look-alike jump the chain reaches node 13 by decision 29 while requested-goal votes occur 0.59-0.84 m from the goal; an unbounded V2 that latches there can confirm a wrong stop

premature_rep_d22.question: premature confirmation
premature_rep_d22.why: v1: after A's decision-22 look-alike jump the chain reaches node 13 by decision 29 while requested-goal votes occur 0.59-0.84 m from the goal; an unbounded V2 that latches there can confirm a wrong stop

stage_3_criteria.design: fresh complete episodes on true (4), truncated (4) and swap (1) chains for each passing component, its v1 counterpart and A (V2a/V2b: C1; R2: B1x and B1; B1: A)
stage_3_criteria.retain: no contact regression against the counterpart and A (raw count and contacts per metre) AND the primary outcome no worse than the counterpart on every condition: V2a/V2b: correct stops >= C1, wrong stops <= C1, and zero wrong stops on true chains; R2: recovery successes >= B1x when either arm has a lost entry (else that condition's recovery is NOT_TESTED and only wrong stops <= B1x is required); B1: correct stops >= A
stage_3_criteria.revise: a contact regression, or a primary outcome worse than the counterpart on any condition
stage_3_criteria.reporting: counts per variant x condition over all attempts; no significance claims
stage_3_criteria.admission: only components whose stage-2 gate is PASS run stage 3, with A and their counterparts

retry_rule: each planned attempt may be rerun once, under a new collection tag, only after an infrastructure failure (the route's attempt is not PASS); a PASS attempt is never rerun; the counted attempt is the first PASS in launch order; every collection found for a trial and variant (v2-<trial>-<variant>-*) is listed in the report; a route without a PASS after its one rerun is a missing attempt and makes its gate INCOMPLETE
trial_identity: the collector records component_variant.trial and .stage in every manifest; the analysis checks them; stage-3 collections must be launched after the stage-2 result file and only for components whose stage-2 gate is PASS (plus comparators A, B1, B1x, C1)
